title: profile-as-code — user profile contract (v1.2)
description: Contract source (D3) for a profile-data workspace. The core `load()` parses content/*.yaml, merges them into a single Profile and validates against THIS schema. Facts (dates, DOIs, URLs, ORCID) are language-independent and are the GEO anchor. Every text field is a langMap ({lang: value}) with EN required (D8, §11). Additive since v1 (semver minor): every earlier workspace still validates. v1.1: role as langMap (org stays invariant string), highlights as string[] per lang, publication.authors/url, root languages + education, identity.handle/timezone, patreon in checks; brand flavor (D15/§17) — `flavor`, org identity variant (orgName/logo/brandVoice/mission/tagline/established), socialHandles/newsletter/podcast/press/audiences blocks, brand platforms, handle checks. New in v1.2 (D16): platform set = Postiz parity + operator extras — 43 platforms, one shared enum for both flavors, single-source dedup guard (check.platform).

identity.description: Canonical identity. THE source of truth for URLs and names (GEO anchor).

flavor.description: v1.1 (additive): workspace flavor (D15). person (default, absent = person) or brand. Brand enables the org identity variant, the socialHandles/newsletter/podcast/press/audiences blocks and Organization GEO (§17).

socialHandles.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand handle matrix — one row per platform with claim status. Seeded from the operator's brand-handles availability sweep (§17).

newsletter.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand's newsletter surface (Substack/Ghost).

podcast.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand's podcast (Spotify show/RSS).

press.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): media mentions of the brand (verifiable, dated).

audiences.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): brand audiences — reader profiles (not recruiters). Audience name → per-lang angle (same shape as positioning.audiences; brand-facing).

positioning.description: Value proposition: statement, per-audience angles, GEO intent.

bios.description: Curated bio per platform+lang+length. Generated by `pasco refine`, chosen by the user, stored here.

headlines.description: Headline per platform+lang (the 1-line under the name).

education.description: v1.1 (additive): formal education. v1 workspaces keep education inside experience[] with role = degree.

languages.description: v1.1 (additive): spoken languages. v1 workspaces document them as comments in skills.yaml.

publications.description: Peer-reviewed / citable output. DOI/ORCID resolvable → GEO citability.

keywords.description: SEO per platform + GEO associations/claims (cross-cutting layer, D7).

checks.description: User-level declarative checks; unioned with the platform skill's checks.yaml by `pasco check`.

active.description: Which bio/headline variant is LIVE per platform (D11: user picks, engine records).

lang.description: Supported languages. EN required (international recruiters), ES native, FR desirable (D8).

langMap.description: Text in one or more languages. EN is ALWAYS required — a schema rule enforced by `pasco validate` (§11). Key restriction via propertyNames (enum en/es/fr).

langMapList.description: v1.1 (additive): like langMap but values are string arrays (bullets). Used by experience.highlights to express list-shaped content per language.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Facts are language-independent (GEO anchor). Month/year precision allowed (YYYY-MM via YYYY-MM-01).

platform.description: Platform set (ONE source, dedup). v1: person surfaces. v1.1 (additive, brand §17): brand surfaces + the socialHandles matrix key space. v1.2 (additive, D16): Postiz parity + operator extras — 43 platforms; new slugs Postiz-aligned verbatim (linkedin-page, instagram-standalone, devto, gmb, warpcast, moltbook, mewe, tumblr); ghost is an operator extra Postiz lacks (docs.postiz.com llms.txt: 34 providers, fetched 2026-09-02).

orgName.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): legal/registered org name when it differs from the display name (name = display, e.g. 'Topia Press').

logo.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): logo URL (schema.org Organization logo).

brandVoice.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): tone matrix seed — tone + values + avoid. Per-platform voice lives in the platform skill.

mission.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand's mission (schema.org Organization description).

tagline.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the one-line tagline (schema.org Organization slogan).

established.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): founding date (schema.org Organization foundingDate).

links.description: Canonical link set. Renderers and skills read URLs ONLY from here — no per-platform URL duplication (drift source).

audiences.description: Audience name → per-lang angle (e.g. recruiter / client / academia).

semanticAssociations.description: 3-5 anchors an LLM should associate with the person (e.g. 'física', 'innovación educativa', 'soberanía de IA'). Seeded without stuffing (§8).

geoKeywords.description: Terms a generative engine should match this skill with (GEO layer, D7).

platformWeights.description: How much this skill matters per platform (0..1). Feeds renderer keyword placement.

role.description: v1: string. v1.1 (additive): langMap — bilingual role titles.

org.description: Proper noun — invariant across languages (e.g. 'USFQ', 'Nimbus Labs'). Not a langMap: institutions are never translated (SPEC §11).

highlights.description: v1: langMap of strings (separator-delimited). v1.1 (additive): langMap of string arrays (bullets).

experienceItem.description: start <= end is NOT expressible in JSON Schema — enforced by core.driftCheck (§12 note).

degree.description: v1.1: degree title (string or bilingual langMap).

institution.description: Proper noun — invariant across languages (e.g. 'Universidad Central de Venezuela'). Not a langMap: institutions are never translated (SPEC §11).

field.description: v1.1: field of study (string or bilingual langMap).

evidenceItem.description: Verifiable claim with source. Anti-pattern: unverifiable claims (dropped by cite-aware systems, §8).

authors.description: v1.1: author string (e.g. 'Luciani, C.' or 'Zambrano et al.').

url.description: v1.1: resolvable URL for outputs without DOI (preprint, conference abstract).

publication.description: DOI/ORCID must be resolvable — GEO citability anchor (LLMs resolve them).

seo.description: Per-platform SEO keyword sets (fed by each platform skill's research).

platform.description: Dedup contract: MUST equal ['all', ...$defs/platform.enum] — scripts/schema-check asserts it (D16).

rule.description: Rule catalog (extensible). Skills' checks.yaml use the same catalog; `pasco check` runs the union. v1.1 (brand §17): handle-claimed (a claimed handle must resolve to a URL) and handle-consistent (handle matrix coherent across surfaces).

activeEntry.description: The chosen variant id — user picked it (D11); variant body lives in the workspace variants store.

brandVoice.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): tone matrix seed — overall tone (langMap), core values, words/tones to avoid. Per-platform voice refinement lives in the platform skill (§17).

url.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): direct profile URL. A claimed handle should carry one, or match an identity.links entry (drift rule handle-claimed-not-linked).

socialHandle.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): one row of the brand handle matrix (platform → handle + claim status). Seed source: the operator's brand-handles availability sweep (§17).

newsletterPlatform.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): newsletter hosts the engine models (Substack now, Ghost later).

newsletter.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand's newsletter surface. The name/description double as the GEO-visible text (RSS/LLM-readable).

podcastPlatform.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): podcast distribution modeled in v1.1 (Spotify for Creators / standalone RSS).

podcast.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): the brand's podcast — show metadata + RSS (GEO-citable via RSS).

pressItem.description: v1.1 (additive, brand): a media mention — outlet, headline, resolvable URL, date (verifiable claims, §8).
